subject: CMA Awards 2026
title: When are the CMA Awards 2026? Date, time, channel and host
answer: The 60th annual CMA Awards are Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026, at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, starting at 7 p.m. Central (8 p.m. Eastern). The show airs live on ABC and streams on Disney+, and it is available on Hulu the next day. Lainey Wilson hosts for the third year in a row.
body:
The Country Music Association Awards, often shortened to the CMAs, mark their 60th edition this year. Ella Langley leads the nominations with nine, including for "Choosin' Texas," with her mentor Miranda Lambert close behind, according to the Associated Press. Ben West and Kacey Musgraves have five nominations each, and Cody Johnson, Chris Stapleton and Stephen Wilson Jr. have four each.

The Entertainer of the Year nominees are Luke Combs, Cody Johnson, Ella Langley, Chris Stapleton and Lainey Wilson, who is seeking a repeat win. The New Artist of the Year nominees are Avery Anna, Carter Faith, Emily Ann Roberts, Tucker Wetmore and Stephen Wilson Jr.

Winners are chosen by voting members of the Country Music Association, which is made up of people who work in the country music industry.
